title: An Allergen BioCube (ABC) Study Evaluating the Onset of Action of Fluticasone Furoate Nasal Spray and Olopatadine Nasal Spray Compared to Placebo
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the onset of action of fluticasone furoate nasal spray compared to olopatadine nasal spray and placebo nasal spray in reducing nasal allergic signs and symptoms following ragweed exposure in the Allergen BioCube (ABC) after single dose administration and six consecutive days of treatment.
